title: Retry VCF Installer depot token updates idempotently
prompt: Implement the exported Set-VcfInstallerDepotToken function in src/VcfInstaller.Depot/VcfInstaller.Depot.psm1. The runner installs the genuine VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer PowerCLI module version 13.5.0.25380678 as an environment prerequisite; use Initialize-VcfInstallerDepotAccount, Initialize-VcfInstallerDepotSettings, and Invoke-VcfInstallerUpdateDepotSettings rather than a direct HTTP client. Build one online VMware depot representation and reuse that same representation for every attempt of the idempotent updateDepotSettings PUT. DownloadToken is required. Add downloadActivationCode only when the caller actually bound DownloadActivationCode. All other optional DepotAccount and DepotSettings fields must remain unset and must therefore be omitted from the JSON wire body: do not send username, password, status, message, offlineAccount, depotConfiguration, nulls, empty strings, zeroes, or false placeholders. RetryCount is the number of retries after the first attempt. Retry HTTP 408, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, and ambiguous transport failures with no HTTP status, but do not retry other HTTP 4xx responses. RetryDelaySeconds=0 must be supported for deterministic operation. Return the successful SDK response and rethrow the final/non-retryable error unchanged. Keep the existing public function signature and module manifest compatible. Do not use Invoke-RestMethod, Invoke-WebRequest, WebClient, HttpClient, curl, or another direct HTTP client. Do not vendor, replace, or intercept the VMware prerequisite. The authoritative projection is docs/contract.json and its pinned specification provenance is docs/official_sources.json. The verifier uses the genuine SDK only against a contract-pinned loopback VCF Installer mock, checks the exact request wire shape and omission semantics, and never contacts a live VMware endpoint.
